title: Pixel platform forensic audits: Loop 1, supervisory capability map, sufficiency verdict, cross-repo reconciliation
intent: Four read-only forensic audits of the legacy pixel platform (services/photo-vectorizer + services/blueprint-import) and its cross-repo relationship with vectorizer-sandbox, delivered as owner-gated checkpoints. Each answers a question that was previously being answered from terminology rather than from traced calls and measured evidence.
behavior_change: None. Five documentation artifacts under docs/audit/. No production code, no configuration, no route, no schema, no test. Nothing in this PR is imported or executed by any runtime path.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Checkpoint 1 (PIXEL_PLATFORM_LOOP1_FORENSIC_AUDIT.md): 157-path census, static call graph and a runtime witness on a real input. Establishes that GeometryCoachV2 shipped 2026-03-15, eighteen days BEFORE the three-loop document that names it, so the 'Loop 1' label is retrospective; and that the coach is not a pixel mechanism -- zero cv2 call sites, deciding on six dimensionless scores and millimetre-space instrument-family priors while only actuating pixel stages. Checkpoint 2 (PIXEL_PLATFORM_SUPERVISORY_CAPABILITY_MAP.md): seven natural joints named for what they do, with typed exchange states; no learning joint exists; arbitration was extracted into contour_election.py and then never adopted, production still using the inline elect_body_contour_v2. Checkpoint 3 (PIXEL_TECHNOLOGY_SUFFICIENCY_AUDIT.md): the development and testing record, and the written verdict -- lifecycle state EXPORT_SAFE, 'not sufficient for commercial viability', against a ten-item readiness gate of which only G1 was met. Reconciliation (vectorizer_cross_repo_reconciliation_001.md): cross-repo, Toolbox-custody, sandbox read-only; re-derived five inherited claims and refuted two. census_pixel.json is the machine-readable 157-path appendix.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: These replace terminology with traced evidence, and in four places they correct the existing record rather than restating it. The three-loop governance document lists Loop 3 as 'ORPHANED, not wired' when the wiring exists in both repositories behind a default-False flag; it describes Loop 1 as 'scale validation only' when a four-rule bounded retry system with a monotonic improvement gate runs by default in production. The inherited cross-repo framing would have misclassified POS-007/008 as solving a deliberately constrained problem, and recorded a capability as stalled inside a graduation process it had never entered. Each correction is anchored to a commit or an executed witness rather than to a reading.

commands_run: census: 157 paths ever created under the two services -- 107 LIVE, 37 BOTH, 8 MIGRATED_TO_SANDBOX, 4 RELOCATED, 1 DELETED. State assigned by positive evidence, never by grep-absence.

runtime witness on Guitar Plans/El Cuatro/El Cuatro 1.pdf: ownership_score 0.501 < 0.600 -> coach_action rerun_body_isolation, retry_count 1; elect_body_contour_v2 logged x3; Export blocked, no SVG/DXF/JSON emitted

domain proof: geometry_coach_v2.py and geometry_authority.py contain 0 cv2 call sites; agentic_supervisor.py (VS) contains 17

reconciliation re-derivation: 5 inherited claims checked, 3 CONFIRMED (14,436 LOC production IBG; mounted /api/body/solve-* routes; zero graduations), 2 REFUTED (POS-006 prior-prohibition; svgwrite as the Step-0 cause)
vectorizer-sandbox read-only throughout and unmodified -- its untracked files timestamp to 2026-06-16 and 2026-07-23, weeks before this session

files.intent: Checkpoint 1. Census, call graph, runtime witness. Establishes the retrospective nature of the Loop 1 label and that Loop 1's controller is spec-domain, not pixel-domain.
Checkpoint 2. Seven joints by responsibility and exchange, typed isolation states, loop vocabulary applied only at the end and only as a mapping question.
Checkpoint 3. Development and testing record, and the written sufficiency verdict with its measured causes.
Cross-repo reconciliation, Toolbox custody, sandbox read-only. Frozen as VECTOR-CROSS-REPO-RECONCILIATION-001 by owner ruling.
Machine-readable 157-path census appendix: path, first-seen date and commit, state, sandbox paths, relocation targets.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Documentation only; no architectural surface, no production code touched. The audits identify defects in existing systems -- a permanently-false VECTORIZER_AVAILABLE flag, an unadopted arbitration module, an undeclared PyMuPDF dependency in the sandbox -- but deliberately repair none of them. Each is recorded with a candidate repair and an explicit 'not applied' so that remediation remains a separate, owner-authorized decision.
